 Neymar to miss Santos v Palmeiras after third booking 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Neymar will miss Santos' derby against Palmeiras on Wednesday after receiving his third yellow card, which triggers a suspension.
 The number 10 was already one booking away from a ban and was cautioned during Saturday's match against Bahia.
 OneFootball Videos
 The caution came in the 31st minute of the first half following an altercation with Rodrigo Nestor.
 After being fouled, the Santos forward threw the ball at the Bahia player, who went to ground. Neymar then tried to lift him and Nestor reacted, prompting a brief scuffle.
 The fixture is scheduled for 19:30 at Vila Belmiro in the 33rd round of the Campeonato Brasileiro.
